data.rationale: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Contract Assets + Prepaids
Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + Deferred Income
Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + Other Reserves
Contract Assets & Work in Progress = Accrued Income + Unbilled WIP + Contract Fulfilment Assets
Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. Depreciation + Goodwill & Intangibles + Other
Non-Current Liabilities = Borrowings + Leases + Pension Deficit & Provisions
Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Lease Payments + Equity
Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions

data.expression: SUM(cf-ni, cf-da, cf-dar, cf-dinv, cf-dap, cf-dwc)
data.rationale: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit After Tax + D&A + Working Capital
Cost to Serve = Third-Party Costs + Delivery Workforce + Delivery Platforms & Sites
Depreciation & Amortisation = Right-of-Use Assets + Equipment + Software
Adjusted Operating Profit = EBITDA − D&A
Adjusted Operating Margin % = Operating Profit / Revenue x 100
Adjusted EBITDA = Contract Margin − Overheads
Adjusted EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Revenue x 100
Adjusted Profit Before Tax = Operating Profit + Net Finance & Other
Free Cash Flow = CFO + CapEx
Contract Margin = Revenue − Cost to Serve
Contract Margin % = Contract Margin / Revenue x 100
Adjusted Profit After Tax = Profit Before Tax − Income Tax
Net Margin % = Profit After Tax / Revenue x 100
Net Finance Costs & Other = Finance Income − Finance Costs + Other
Overheads = Bid & Account Management + Technology & AI + Group Functions
Revenue = Contract Revenue − KPI Service Credits & Rebates
